<style>@keyframes fynSweep{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(400%)}}@keyframes fynPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(16,185,129,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(16,185,129,0)}}@keyframes fynWords{0%,18%{transform:translateY(0)}25%,43%{transform:translateY(-1.3em)}50%,68%{transform:translateY(-2.6em)}75%,93%{transform:translateY(-3.9em)}100%{transform:translateY(-5.2em)}}.fyn-stat-num .elementor-heading-title{background:none!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor!important}.fyn-stat-num,.fyn-stat-num *{visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}</style><script data-no-optimize="1" data-no-defer="1" data-cfasync="false">(function(){if(window.__fynLib)return;window.__fynLib=1;var END=0.45;
function prog(el){var vh=innerHeight||document.documentElement.clientHeight;if(!vh)return 1;var t=el.getBoundingClientRect().top;return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(vh-t)/(vh-vh*END)));}
function run(){[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.fyn-live'),function(el){if(el.__to==null){var raw=el.getAttribute('data-to')||el.textContent;el.__d=(String(raw).split(/[.,]/)[1]||'').length;el.__to=parseFloat(String(raw).replace(',','.'))||0;}el.textContent=(el.__to*prog(el)).toFixed(el.__d).replace('.',',');});}
var q=0;function on(){if(!q){q=requestAnimationFrame(function(){q=0;run();});}}
addEventListener('scroll',on,{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',on);document.addEventListener('scroll',on,{passive:true,capture:true});
function init(){run();var y=new Date().getFullYear();[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.fyn-year'),function(e){e.textContent=y;});[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.fyn-top a,a.fyn-top'),function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});});});}
if(document.readyState!=='loading')init();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init);addEventListener('load',run);setInterval(run,300);
setInterval(function(){var vh=innerHeight;[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.fyn-lib .elementor-invisible'),function(e){var r=e.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.top<vh*.95&&r.bottom>0){if(!e.__s){e.__s=Date.now();return;}if(Date.now()-e.__s>1500){e.classList.remove('elementor-invisible');e.style.visibility='visible';e.style.opacity='1';}}});},400);})();</script>
